title: East Austin Equitable Growth Ideas
summary:
*   A community event was held to gather input on future development in East Austin.
*   The discussion focused on identifying core values and guiding principles for equitable economic growth.
*   Attendees shared ideas and goals for improving amenities and fostering economic development in the area.
*   Council members were present to listen to community perspectives, but no official actions or votes were taken.
